description: NIST's FTC-07 whole. It reads: edge #1963 fitted past the cap (real/pcurve-fit-reported-as-gap), and the pcurves of its B-spline faces, once 6e-7 past their knot domain, held inside it (ADR-0026's amendment of step 5). The checker at Full then cannot decide S5 for the fillet torus f30 (and f32) against the plane f197, tilted 2° and within 0.08 of the torus's rim: intersect_surfaces refuses the section as UnresolvedTurning. Its operands wait as an ignored test in arris-geom (a_torus_rim_beside_a_tilted_plane_is_decided); the part waits here until the intersector decides the pair
